BiblicalUsage: Bunni stands among the Levites who cried to the LORD when the people returned to the law, and his name turns up again among those who sealed the covenant and in the line of Hashabiah. He belongs to the generation that rebuilt worship after the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps the names of faithful Levites, and Bunni is remembered because he stood and prayed with his people.
